subject: Speedometer
author: thephilofwar
body:
I chose speedometer to make a point, because despite the opinions of some, it IS an important part of the HUD of a driving/racing game, irregardless of the game being an arcade racer or driving simulation.

However, the accelerator and brakes would go hand in hand as most important, essential to driving; followed by the boost bar, essential to Burnout; then the speedometer, essential to the HUD of any driving game; then the boost start (simply something for online with no use in single player); and drift jumping is entirely unimportant. Drift jumping is a glitch that had no place in the game in the first place.

__________
